articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

**그리고** is an independent adverbial connector. The National Institute of Korean Language defines it as connecting words, phrases, clauses, or sentences by addition; this entry is limited to that additive function.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). 그리고. In *Korean Basic Dictionary*. National Institute of Korean Language. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=62240&nation=eng

Korean Basic Dictionary, entry 그리고, definition and examples: additive linkage among words, phrases, clauses, and sentences.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **V-고 V**, **V-아/어서**, **-고 vs -아/어서** y otras formas de conexión discursiva.
